title: Version snapshot store and history diff
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli --test cli versions_ and cargo test -p pdfxi-cli --bin pdfxi versions pass; pdfxi versions snapshot/list/diff/remove work on a JSON store of real page-text snapshots; MANAGE-005 moves to verified.
notes: Adds a versioned JSON snapshot store (atomic writes, monotonic ids, bounded pages/lines) and diffs ids or live PDFs with pdfxi_edit::compare.
